items.originalTitle: From classroom to the circuit with @Valvoline. In Mexico, the next generation of mechanics are building their knowledge through hands-on classroom wor...
items.summaryEn:
From classroom to the circuit with @Valvoline.
In Mexico, the next generation of mechanics are building their knowledge through hands-on classroom workshops, learning the skills and precision that bring motorsport to life.
Because every Original starts somewhere, and never stops learning.
detailZh:
从教室到赛道，与@Valvoline同行。
在墨西哥，新一代的机械师通过实际操作的课堂研讨会积累知识，学习那些让赛车运动生动起来的技能和精度。
因为每个原装产品都始于某个地方，并且永远不会停止学习。
detailEn:
From classroom to the circuit with @Valvoline.
In Mexico, the next generation of mechanics are building their knowledge through hands-on classroom workshops, learning the skills and precision that bring motorsport to life.
Because every Original starts somewhere, and never stops learning.
